title: Practice: Claude in a repository's workflow (Python)

blocks.text: Practice: Claude in a repository's workflow

A team wants Claude in its pull request workflow: it answers when someone writes `@claude` on an issue or a pull request, it reviews every pull request, its prompts are versioned like code, and every run is bounded. All of that is plain files in the repository. In this practice you write them for a small service, the invoice API, and tests read the project, using the course's own model of the documented rules (`examples/40-workflow-lint`).

The tests are the same in all four languages. The files are YAML and Markdown, and the Java and Kotlin tests read the YAML with Jackson's YAML module and apply the same linter (`examples/40-workflow-lint`, in your language). Nothing here calls GitHub or the network.

`starter/` is the working project with eleven gaps cut out of it (marked `GAP n` in comments, each with one example and the cases it unlocks). Everything else is written and correct: the triggers, the concurrency groups, the checkout steps, the review workflow's permissions and triggers. The files are configuration, not code, so there is no `log` line to add: when a case fails, the test message names the file and the rule, and a run shows it under the failing case. About fourteen lines in all.
What is already written, and what you write

items: `.github/workflows/claude.yml`, the job `if` unlocks `m1`: start the runner only for `@claude` comments.
`claude.yml`, the job `timeout-minutes` unlocks `e4`.
`claude.yml`, the job `permissions` unlocks `m1`: `contents`, `pull-requests`, `issues` and `id-token` all `write`.
`claude.yml`, the action step unlocks `m1`: `@v1` and the key read from `secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (the starter has the beta action and a placeholder).
`claude.yml`, `claude_args` with `--max-turns` unlocks `e4`.
`.github/workflows/review.yml`, `plugin_marketplaces`, `plugins` and `prompt` unlock `e1`.
`review.yml`, the `--allowedTools` part of `claude_args` unlocks `e1`.
`CLAUDE.md`, the Git workflow bullets unlock `e3`.
`REVIEW.md`, a second bullet under Always check unlocks `e3`.
`REVIEW.md`, the bullets under Skip unlock `e3`.
`prompts/triage.md` gets a `version`, and `prompts/CHANGELOG.md` gets its entry: together they unlock `e2`.
`CLAUDE.md`, the address in the CI bullet unlocks `e5`: replace it with a placeholder address, or remove it.
`.github/workflows/claude.yml`, the mention workflow, named `claude`:
triggers: `issue_comment` and `pull_request_review_comment`, both only for `created`;
the job `claude` runs only when `github.event.comment.body` contains `@claude`, so a runner is not started for other comments;
a `timeout-minutes` of 30 or less and a `concurrency` group that is named after the issue or pull request number;
permissions `contents`, `pull-requests`, `issues` and `id-token` all `write`;

steps: `actions/checkout` first (any `v` version), then one `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` step with the key as `${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}` and `claude_args` holding `--max-turns` of 10 or fewer.
`.github/workflows/review.yml`, the review workflow, with the job `review`:
trigger: `pull_request` with the types `opened`, `synchronize`, `ready_for_review` and `reopened`, in that order;
permissions `contents: read` and `id-token: write` (a reviewer reads the code), with `pull-requests` and `issues` set to `read`;

checkout first, then the action step; its `prompt` runs the `/code-review` skill with `--comment` so findings are posted, its `claude_args` names `mcp__github_inline_comment__create_inline_comment` after `--allowedTools` and holds `--max-turns` of 10 or fewer, and it installs a plugin named `code-review@<marketplace>` with `plugin_marketplaces` and `plugins`;
a timeout of 30 minutes or less and a concurrency group named after the pull request number with `cancel-in-progress: true`, so a new push replaces a running review.

`prompts/triage.md`: a semantic `version` in its frontmatter. `prompts/CHANGELOG.md` has one `## <version>` heading per version, newest first, and the newest heading equals the prompt's version. Add the entry for the version you set.
`REVIEW.md`, the guidance the reviewer reads: a `## Always check` section and a `## Skip` section, each with at least two bullets, and each naming a path in backticks.

`CLAUDE.md`: the branch name `feature/<ticket>` in backticks, a rule that a commit message states why the change is needed (the words "commit message"), the pull request rule (the words "pull request") and the sentence "never commit to `main`".
No file in the project holds a key, a personal path or an address.

blocks.text:
name: Claude
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
concurrency:
  group: claude-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  claude:
    if: contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      id-token: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_args: --max-turns 8

name: Claude review
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, ready_for_review, reopened]
concurrency:
  group: review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          plugin_marketplaces: "https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code.git"
          plugins: "code-review@claude-code-plugins"
          prompt: "/code-review:code-review --comment ${{ github.repository }}/pull/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
          claude_args: '--max-turns 8 --allowedTools "mcp__github_inline_comment__create_inline_comment"'

# Invoice API

## Commands

- Tests: `make test`. Lint: `make lint`.

## Git workflow

- Branches are named `feature/<ticket>`; never commit to `main`.
- A commit message starts with the ticket id and says why the change is needed.
- Every change goes through a pull request that links the ticket.

## CI

- Claude runs in GitHub Actions: on `@claude` mentions and as a reviewer on every pull request.
- Prompts live in `prompts/`. Change one only with a new version and a changelog entry.

# Review guidance

## Always check

- Money amounts are integer cents, never floats, in `src/billing/`.
- Every new endpoint in `src/api/handlers/` has a test under `tests/api/`.
- A database change comes with a migration in `migrations/`.

## Skip

- Formatting and import order: the linter owns them.
- Generated files under `src/generated/`.

# Prompt changelog

## 1.2.0

- triage: ask for one sentence of reasoning.

## 1.1.0

- triage: add the question label.

---
name: triage
version: 1.2.0
---
Classify the issue as bug, feature or question. Reply with the label and one sentence of reasoning.

name: Claude
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
concurrency:
  group: claude-${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  claude:
    # GAP 1 (unlocks m1): start the runner only for comments that mention @claude.
    # Add `if: contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')` here, on the job.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # GAP 2 (unlocks e4): bound the time of a run. Example: timeout-minutes: 20 (30 or less).
    # GAP 3 (unlocks m1): this job writes. Give contents, pull-requests, issues and id-token the value write.
    # Example: `issues: write` on its own line under permissions.
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
      # GAP 4 (unlocks m1): use the stable v1 action, and read the key from the secrets context.
      # Example: anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      - uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@beta
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: replace-with-a-secret-reference
          # GAP 5 (unlocks e4): cap the turns. Example: claude_args: --max-turns 8 (10 or fewer).

name: Claude review
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, ready_for_review, reopened]
concurrency:
  group: review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          # GAP 6 (unlocks e1): install the review plugin and run its skill so that findings are posted.
          # Needs plugin_marketplaces (a git URL), plugins ("code-review@<marketplace>") and prompt
          # (the /code-review skill with --comment). Example: plugins: "code-review@claude-code-plugins"
          claude_args: --max-turns 8
          # GAP 7 (unlocks e1): claude_args must also name the inline comment tool after --allowedTools.
          # Example: --max-turns 8 --allowedTools "mcp__github_inline_comment__create_inline_comment"

# Invoice API

## Commands

- Tests: `make test`. Lint: `make lint`.

## Git workflow

through a merge request that links the ticket; and a sentence saying never to commit to the main branch (the branch name in backticks). -->

## CI

- Failed runs are reported to ci-alerts@team.example.org (replace this address with a placeholder such as contact@example.com).
- Prompts live in `prompts/`. Change one only with a new version and a changelog entry.

## Always check

- Money amounts are integer cents, never floats, in `src/billing/`.
